messages:
Alex Chen: quick sync — putting together an interop preflight for the LangChain/LlamaIndex tooling + gateway handshake. want to run a lint/poke pass before we spin up the pilot infra.
Mira Patel: +1. can we confirm which tool invocation patterns we need to support? sync vs streaming vs tool_call?
Alex Chen: priority order: tool_call (structured JSON), streaming tool outputs, then legacy sync. most partners expect tool_call first.
Jordan (eng-sdks): FYI SDK change is tiny — added a ToolInvocation v2 wrapper. landing PR tomorrow. example manifest below for the gateway to validate:```yaml
name: redwood-ll-index-connector
version: 0.1.0
entrypoint: /connectors/ll-index
capabilities:
  - tool_call
  - streaming
auth: token
```
Samir Gomez: nice. can we add timeout/backpressure fields? partners hit the 60s timeouts in the last pilot.
Alex Chen: yep — suggested fields: request_timeout_ms, max_concurrent_calls, retry_policy. Jordan — can SDK accept them?
Jordan (eng-sdks): yes, adding optional fields. CLI lint command will surface missing keys: `rwd-tooling-lint path/to/manifest.yaml`
Priya Reddy: ops question — marketplace listing needs copy and joint announce plan. who owns the co-marketing timeline?
Mira Patel: Partnerships owns ask + intro, product owns tech readiness signoff, marketing + PR set the cadence. Suggest we aim for internal MLP (mini launch plan) by next wed.
Alex Chen: action items: 1) Jordan add manifest schema + lint rule (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Samir run gateway compatibility test matrix against live router (due Fri). 3) Priya draft co-marketing brief (due Mon). 4) Mira coordinate partner intro + NDA check.
Samir Gomez: I'll also add a quick script to simulate 200 concurrent tool_calls with KV cache warm. will post results in this thread.
Jordan (eng-sdks): PR link once ready — will include sample code snippet and the CLI lint rule.
CI-Bot: build/test pipeline — `tooling-lint` integration job queued (job #4821).
Priya Reddy: for announcement embargos: partners ask for a 48h review window. include in brief.
Alex Chen: noted. one more: can we get a tiny sample app (Next.js + example langchain flow) for the marketplace tile? Jordan/Mira — can you pair on that?
Mira Patel: yep, Jordan and I can pair Thu morning.
Jordan (eng-sdks): works for me. I'll stub out the sample app and a README.
Alex Chen: cool. if no objections I'll mark this as the canonical preflight checklist and we can spin up the pilot once lint passes. :thumbsup:
Mira Patel: :thumbsup: thanks all, will update calendar invite for Thu pairing.
Priya Reddy: added vendor comms checklist to the drive and shared in #partners-docs.
Alex Chen: closing loop — update here with PR links and test artifacts.
